title:
A kit built for
real moments.
intro: A considered collection of cameras, lenses and lighting tools I rely on to document stories with care, wherever the day takes us.
note: The right tools matter. Knowing when to use them matters even more.

items.name: Sony α7 IV
items.description: A full-frame hybrid camera at the heart of my wedding and portrait work.

items.name: Sony FE 28–70mm F2 GM
items.description: My go-to standard zoom, with a constant F2 aperture for beautiful subject separation and low-light flexibility.

items.name: Tamron 28–75mm F/2.8
items.description: A versatile standard zoom for adapting quickly as moments unfold.

items.name: Sony FE 50mm F1.8
items.description: A compact prime for intimate frames and a natural field of view.

items.name: Sony FE 85mm F1.8
items.description: A portrait focal length for expressive close-ups and beautifully separated subjects.

items.name: Nanlite PavoTube II
items.description: Tube lighting for adding atmosphere, colour and controlled accents to a scene.

items.name: Godox iT32
items.description: A compact flash option for situations where the available light needs a little support.

items.name: Memory cards
items.description: Memory cards used to keep every part of the shoot moving.
